# Boqin Yuan

> Machine learning engineer working across the LLM stack: AI agent development and evaluation,
> model training and alignment, and ML systems and inference optimization. MS Computer Science at
> UC San Diego. Previously a full-time ML engineer at CambioML (YC S23).
> Graduating December 2026. Available for full-time roles from January 2027.

Contact: b4yuan@ucsd.edu
Site: https://boqiny.github.io
GitHub: https://github.com/boqiny
LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/boqin-yuan
Google Scholar: https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=AglrzBgAAAAJ

## Focus areas

- **Agent evaluation and benchmarks.** Co-author of SkillsBench and Agents' Last Exam, community
  benchmarks measuring how well LLM agents handle real, expertise-heavy work. Authored a merged
  adapter in Harbor, the 3.7k-star agent-evaluation framework used by Terminal-Bench:
  https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor
- **Agent memory.** Co-author of AMA-Bench (ICML 2026), an evaluation framework for long-horizon
  memory in agentic applications. First author of memory-probe (ICLR 2026 workshop), which separates
  retrieval failures from utilization failures in agent memory.
- **Model training and alignment.** Trained and productionized AnyParser, a 1B/2B vision-language
  model that parses PDFs including tables and charts into structured Markdown, fully fine-tuned and
  preference-aligned on 8xA100s to beat GPT-4 baselines on DocVQA (ANLS).
- **ML systems and inference.** Served a vision-language model at 150 output tokens/s on a single
  L4 GPU with SGLang, deployed on AWS (ECS + Lambda), with per-user Kubernetes-isolated sandbox
  sessions serving over 1,000 users.

## Experience

- **Moody's Analytics** (Jun 2026 - Aug 2026, San Francisco): Software Engineer Intern - AI Agent (internship).
  Agent evaluation for Moody's Banking Decision Intelligence agent, a LangGraph system automating
  analyst workflows in production on AWS: a FastAPI and React service scores every Langfuse trace
  with a step-level eval suite, pairing rubric LLM-as-judge scoring with deterministic tool-call
  checks to pin each failure on the missing domain knowledge. Knowledge iteration: a Claude Agent
  SDK curation agent turns each diagnosis into a versioned skill, injected into the knowledge base
  at runtime with no redeploy.
- **CambioML (YC S23)** (May 2024 - Jul 2025, San Jose): Founding Machine Learning Engineer, full-time.
  Built the AnyParser data pipeline (PDFs sourced from Common Crawl, then cleaned, filtered, and
  annotated to produce ground truth) and trained the model: a 1B/2B vision-language model that parses
  PDFs including tables and charts into structured Markdown, fully fine-tuned and preference-aligned
  on 8xA100s, beating GPT-4 baselines on DocVQA (ANLS), served with SGLang at 150 output tokens/s
  on a single L4 GPU. Core contributor to Energent.ai, a Claude-powered computer-use agent sandbox
  that reached 1,000+ registered users. Separately, built a computer-use gym: a reproducible desktop
  environment with defined tasks, where agent rollouts generate the trajectories used to evaluate
  and post-train CUA agents.
- **Inspur Group** (May 2023 - Aug 2023): ML Engineer Intern. YOLOv7 detection and pose estimation,
  TensorRT inference acceleration.
- **UC San Diego, STABLE Lab** (2025 - present): MS Computer Science, agent memory and ML systems
  research with Prof. Jishen Zhao.
- **UIUC, Supercomputing System and AI Lab (SSAIL)** (Oct 2024 - Mar 2025): Research Assistant with
  Prof. Minjia Zhang. Extended DeepSpeed-Chat, which shipped with PPO only, to preference-based
  post-training: a DPO trainer (reference-policy log-ratios, adaptive KL control) and a best-of-N
  rejection-sampling variant, on DeepSpeed's hybrid engine and ZeRO. Code: https://github.com/boqiny/deepspeed-chat
- **UIUC** (2020 - 2024): BS in Mathematics & Computer Science and in Statistics. Research at NCSA and
  the Illinois Geometry Lab.
